//ConnectionStrings: Intentionally omitted. Provide via the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable or a secret store so credentials are never committed. Production form: 'Server=...;Database=...;User Id=<least-privilege login>;Password=...;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False'. The local dev value lives in appsettings.Development.json.

Crypto.//AllowUnauthenticatedLegacyBlobs: A migration switch, not a setting. Lets the vault read secrets sealed before payloads were bound to their row, and re-seals them on the next start. Turn it on, start once, turn it off: while it is on, the binding can be bypassed by anyone who can write the database.

DataProtection.//: The keys behind every authentication cookie, antiforgery token, TempData and session. KeyRingPath must be a durable directory shared by every node — a mounted volume, not a container's own filesystem — or a restart signs everyone out and replicas cannot read each other's cookies. The ring is encrypted at rest with the vault's KEK, so it need not be secret storage. Required outside Development; startup fails without it unless AllowEphemeralKeys is set for a deliberately throwaway single node.

Vault.//: Only used when Crypto:Engine is 'VaultTransit'. The master key stays in Vault; only the DEK is wrapped/unwrapped there. Provide the token via the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable.

Redis.//: Off by default: a single node uses in-process stores and needs no Redis. Set Enabled=true to move session revocation, the intrusion IP blacklist, and the encrypted-envelope cache into shared Redis — REQUIRED for multi-node scale-out so a revocation or block on one node is enforced by all. RevocationRetentionHours must exceed the cookie ExpireTimeSpan.

AuditSigning.//: Signs audit checkpoints (ECDSA P-256). Provide a persistent key via ECLIPSVAULT_AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY (base64 PKCS#8) for real deployments; startup fails without one unless the dev ephemeral key is allowed.

StepUp.//: Revealing a secret at or above MinimumSensitivity requires a fresh authenticator code when the last strong auth is older than MaxAuthAgeMinutes.

ForwardedHeaders.//: When deployed behind a reverse proxy / load balancer, list the proxy IP(s) here so X-Forwarded-For is trusted only from them. Empty = headers ignored, socket IP used (safe for direct exposure).
